COMPANY OVERVIEW
KKR is a leading global investment firm that offers alternative asset management as well as capital markets and insurance solutions. KKR aims to generate attractive investment returns by following a patient and disciplined investment approach, employing world-class people, and supporting growth in its portfolio companies and communities. KKR sponsors investment funds that invest in private equity, credit and real assets and has strategic partners that manage hedge funds. KKR’s insurance subsidiaries offer retirement, life and reinsurance products under the management of Global Atlantic Financial Group. References to KKR’s investments may include the activities of its sponsored funds and insurance subsidiaries.
POSITION SUMMARY
Global Atlantic seeks a highly motivated Annuity Director to join our distribution team in a client-facing, externally focused role serving the Independent Marketing Organization (IMO) channel. This team-based position works collaboratively with National Accounts and Internal Sales Support to represent Global Atlantic's strategies and solutions to IMO partners and their sales forces (marketers). The Annuity Director serves as a strategic liaison between Global Atlantic and distribution partners, responsible for driving sales growth, deepening relationships, and ensuring effective communication and execution of our value proposition in the marketplace.
TEAM STRUCTURE & COLLABORATION
The Annuity Director operates within a collaborative team environment consisting of:
National Accounts
Partners closely with SVP National Accounts and Strategic Partnerships to develop and execute account-based business strategies
Aligns on territory priorities, account segmentation, and strategic initiatives
Coordinates on key account planning and relationship escalation
Internal Sales Support
Collaborates with internal wholesalers to develop new and established relationships
Leverages internal resources for proposal development, product expertise, and client servicing
Ensures seamless coordination between field activities and home office support
This team-based approach ensures strategic alignment, operational efficiency, and a unified client experience across all touchpoints.
CORE RESPONSIBILITIES
External Relationship Management & Client Engagement
Primary Accountability: Serve as the face of Global Atlantic to IMO partners and their sales forces, delivering strategies and solutions that drive business growth.
Develop and maintain strong, productive, and profitable relationships with assigned IMO distribution partners to capture market share and exceed sales goals in the annuity channel
Manage client relationships primarily through face-to-face engagement, supplemented by telephone and email communications, ensuring consistent presence and accessibility
Represent Global Atlantic's strategies, products, and solutions to IMO leadership and their sales forces (marketers), positioning our value proposition effectively in competitive situations
Deliver presentations and communicate the Global Atlantic story with clarity, consistency, and impact to diverse audiences including IMO executives, sales leaders, and field marketers
Strategic Execution & Sales Performance
Meet and exceed annuity sales goals for assigned accounts through disciplined territory management and relationship development
Execute account-based business strategies in partnership with National Accounts leadership, ensuring alignment between corporate objectives and field execution
Maintain deep understanding of the competitive landscape within the insurance industry, using market intelligence to inform strategy and positioning
Explain features, benefits, and advantages of Global Atlantic products to clients with precision and persuasive impact
Operational Excellence & Accountability
Utilize deliberate scheduling and calendar management to maximize client time and ensure activities correspond to territory priorities
Manage Salesforce account information and content for all assigned accounts, maintaining data integrity and documentation standards
Manage individual expenses and budget in accordance with company guidelines
Take personal accountability for the execution of goals and objectives, consistently meeting or exceeding performance expectations
KEY COMPETENCIES & QUALIFICATIONS
Experience & Background
7+ years of sales experience in the annuity and life insurance industry, preferably in the IMO annuity channel
Demonstrated success in wholesaling and relationship management with proven ability to drive and increase sales
Bachelor's degree or equivalent combination of education and experience
Skills & Attributes
Excellent communication, presentation, and influencing skills with the ability to deliver information articulately and consistently to external stakeholders
Strong relationship management capabilities, including the ability to build trust, navigate complex organizational structures, and influence decision-makers
Strategic thinking and execution orientation, balancing long-term relationship development with short-term sales objectives
Collaborative mindset with ability to work effectively across internal teams and leverage resources to serve clients
Willingness to quickly learn product lines, procedures, and workflows in a dynamic business environment
Proficiency in expense management, negotiation, and professional communication
Licensing & Travel
Series 7, 63, and Life & Health licenses (or ability to obtain quickly)
Significant travel required – successful candidates may work remotely but must be willing to travel extensively to meet client needs and territory demands
SUCCESS METRICS
Performance in this role will be evaluated based on:
Sales Results: Achievement of annuity sales goals and market share growth in assigned accounts
Relationship Depth: Quality and breadth of relationships with IMO partners and their sales forces
Strategic Alignment: Effectiveness in executing account-based strategies in partnership with National Accounts
Client Satisfaction: Feedback from IMO partners regarding responsiveness, value delivery, and partnership quality
Team Collaboration: Contribution to team objectives and effective utilization of Internal Sales Support resources
Market Intelligence: Quality of competitive insights and ability to position Global Atlantic effectively
ROLE DISTINCTION
This Annuity Director position is distinguished by its:
External, client-facing focus with primary accountability for IMO partner relationships
Team-based operating model requiring close collaboration with National Accounts and Internal Sales Support
Strategic communication responsibility as the voice of Global Atlantic to distribution partners
Dual accountability for both relationship management and sales performance
Field-based execution with significant autonomy and travel requirements
The Annuity Director serves as a critical link between Global Atlantic's corporate strategy and marketplace execution, ensuring our solutions reach advisors and clients through strong, strategically aligned IMO partnerships
